acceptance.item: P5-RT-05-01: the T12 string viewer's node hit areas are below the 6.1 rule at 320 px and on eight-column boards at 360 px, because the panel, not the edge-to-edge figure, is the board's size container
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/T12.spec.ts > regressions > T12 string viewer at {320,360} px on {E8,D8,A7,A8,B8}: every node hit area is {43,38} px (6.1, A-7); and > at 320 pixels the page has no horizontal scroll and the targets are large enough (tightened to the 6.1 side)
acceptance.evidence: Severity: major (no adjustment). Red at base 95d0060: 6 failed, e.g. '/tools/rep/?g=E8&k=8 at 320 x 800: node 1 hit area 39 x 39, expected 43 x 43', A8 and B8 at 320 '34 x 34, expected 38 x 38', A8 at 360 '39 x 39, expected 43 x 43'. The tightened 320 test also failed: 'g=D8&k=8: hit area 39 by 39, expected 43 (7 columns)'. Green after: 7 passed, and in the full T12+M8 run. Cause: Board.svelte reads its unit from the nearest inline-size container, which was the string panel (12 px padding and a 1 px border each side). Fix: .board-host now runs over the panel's padding and border (margin-inline -13px) and is itself the container. CSS only, 0 bytes of JavaScript. Commit 458bf90.

acceptance.item: P5-RT-05-02: when an island hydrates, the server's matrix and relation scroll boxes are replaced, so focus on one of them goes to body
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/T12.spec.ts > regressions > M8 b4: the focus on the server box "relation-left" survives the island's hydration; M8 b3: ... "matrix-e" ...
acceptance.evidence: Severity: major (no adjustment). Red at base: 2 failed, 'Expected: "div in b4 (relation-left)" Received: "BODY"', and the same on b3 matrix-e. Green after the fix and after the size trim: 2 passed in three separate runs. Cause: goLive and activate replace the server's panels, and MatrixView moves only the table into a new box, so the focused box is removed. Fix: before each step, runSteps notes the figure's focused scroll box by its parent's data-out. If the step leaves the focus on body, the box drawn in its place gets the focus: first the server box moved into the live panel, then the live MatrixView's box. Commits ccc90bd and ef8ebf7.

acceptance.item: P5-RT-05-03: a relation verdict computed in the worker is drawn but never announced
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/T12.spec.ts > regressions > a verdict from the worker > M8 b6 / M8 b7: the verdict of a relation picked by keys is announced when the worker's list arrives
acceptance.evidence: Severity: major (no adjustment). Red at base: 2 failed, 'b6: the screen shows the verdict "equal", the live region said only ["[H1, F1] = −2F1: checked in the background."]', and the same for b7 '[H7, F7] = −2F7'. Green after: 2 passed (3 runs). Cause: acceptFromWorker drew the verdict without announcing it. Fix: a relation pick that announces 'checked in the background' records the representation and the pick's announcer, and the worker's list for that representation announces the relation sentence with its verdict. Scope, recorded in the fragment: a failure of the worker and the jump to the first failing relation after a board or node pick are not announced. The announcer of a11y.ts keeps only the last text given within 500 ms, so a second announcement would drop the pick sentence, and the 90 kB limit left no room. I implemented and tested the failure announcement (green), then removed it with its test to fit the shared budget: it and a longer focus selector together cost 70 B. Commits a835fa6 and ef8ebf7.

acceptance.item: P5-RT-06-01: no run without JavaScript reads T12's orbit drawing or matrix cells on M8
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/nojs.spec.ts > nojs.spec.ts rejects a T12 root whose orbit drawing and matrices are blank: modules/m8-lie-algebras/
acceptance.evidence: Severity: minor (no adjustment). Red with the base predicate (the adopted test appended to the base file): 1 failed, accepting 'b1 as board' to 'b12 as board'. Green with the new predicate: 1 passed. The whole nojs.spec.ts sweep passes (84). Cause: toolReport accepted a T12 root as 'board' through its string viewer and read no orbit vertex and no matrix cell. Fix: toolReport now lists the figure parts that have lost their content, and figureProblems rejects a root that has any. An orbit-graph must hold data-positions vertices and at least positions - 1 edges, or layer counts that add up to data-positions. A matrix must hold rows x cols cells as a grid, or one value cell per list row. Commit 453c54b.

openQuestions: Contrived sibling of P5-RT-05-02, not fixed (size budget, untested path): in an island whose digest holds the shown relation (M8 b6, b7), suppose the reader picks a relation the digest lacks, picks back to the digest's relation while the worker list is pending, and focuses a side box. Announcing them without losing the pick sentence needs either a joined sentence or a change to the 500 ms coalescing in site/src/lib/a11y.ts (shared), plus bytes /tools/rep/ does not have after the content fix.

proposedFix of P5-RT-05-02 not followed: MatrixView is unchanged (adopting the server's box would still move a focused element, which drops the focus). The focus is restored in runSteps by data-out, which covers both the panel swap of goLive and the later step in which MatrixView takes over the table.
